grid.request: Audit our field equipment comparison page. Staff compare the depot and daily price and then inspect and pick equipment. Tell us what to keep and what needs to change, using the numbered design-atlas audit judgments for repeated structure, density and visible copy. Explain how you applied each relevant rule to this screen and its content. Provide a read-only report on this version, with selector or screen locations and concrete observations. Use the existing DESIGN.md. Compare the desktop 1440×900 and narrow 390×844 layouts from an empty pick list, at the top of #records and after scrolling that pane to 360 CSS pixels. Recheck the top before moving on; try Inspect, Pick and undo. The page is comparison.html.

proof.request: Polish our proof desk for the next print run. Keep the Nightjar Press look and the job details. Make the ink order, plate selection and revision notice clear. If an area already works, leave it alone. Check the current DESIGN.md and show the evidence for your decisions at desktop 1440×900 and narrow 390×844. Start at the top with Plate A selected, then use the keyboard to choose Plate B. The page is index.html.

ink.request: Audit our proof desk before the next print run. Can a printer read the ink order, choose a plate and see the revision notice? Keep the Nightjar Press look. Report what you find without editing the page. Check the existing DESIGN.md and give the audit judgments with visible evidence at desktop 1440×900 and narrow 390×844. Start at the top with Plate A selected, then use the keyboard to choose Plate B. The page is index.html.

ink-role.request: Audit our proof desk before the next print run. Can a printer read the ink order, choose a plate and see the revision notice? Which uses of colour help the press identify the job, read the data or see which plate is selected? Which visual accents could we quiet without changing any of those meanings? Keep the Nightjar Press look. Report what you find without editing the page. Check the existing DESIGN.md and give the audit judgments with visible evidence at desktop 1440×900 and narrow 390×844. Start at the top with Plate A selected, then use the keyboard to choose Plate B. The page is index.html.
